Source commit: e9d1ca987864f121680bb0d7e9612c05b37748de
Sniptale adapts adjustment, clamped Kawase blur, and advanced bloom kernels.
The adaptations use explicit logical coordinates and the compositor's existing device and resource lifetime.
The bloom adaptation retains valid premultiplied alpha on transparent pixels.
